intended_use: Exploratory linear-elastic screening from literal Bambu PLA Basic raw tensile curves; not a failure model

screening_isotropic.nu_provenance: User-supplied initialization prior; not measured in the cited dataset
screening_isotropic.selection_reason: Isotropic has the lowest BIC; source placement groups do not map completely to local material axes

raw_curve_extraction.fit: affine ordinary least squares after exact-row deduplication

directional_observations.interpretation: Z-upright loading is consistent with the build direction; the other placement groups cannot be uniquely assigned to local bead and in-layer transverse axes from this source.

reported_strength_reference.interpretation: Reference limit only. The linear-elastic solver does not predict failure.

sources.note: Reported overall elastic modulus and tensile strength; associated raw workbook has documented label/count conflicts.

limitations: The raw workbook has 22 curves while the article claims 21.
Source placement labels and summary-workbook specimen labels conflict.
